shortDescription: User profile overview view with GitHub-style profile, repositories, and contribution heatmap.
fullDescription: Presents the user-profile-overview view in its default state with a profile header, avatar sidebar, tabbed profile navigation, popular repository cards, annual contribution heatmap, and contribution activity heading. The view initializes interactive header search, selected profile tab, and contribution year from props and local state while composing shared avatar, badge, button, card, input, separator, and tabs primitives.
